title: How Does Your Heart Keep You Going?
post_title: How Does Your Heart Keep You Going? | QuantaTale
post_description: Your fist-sized heart never takes a break. Here is how it keeps blood moving. Sources: National Institutes of Health https://www.nhlbi.nih.gov/health/heart and Centers for Disease Control and Prevention https://www.cdc.gov/heart-disease/about/index.html #Science #ScienceFacts #QuantaTale
narration: What keeps your blood moving every second of your life? It's your heart, an organ about the size of your fist. It sits in the middle of a web of tubes that reach all over you. Blood delivers the oxygen and nutrients your organs need. Little doors called valves keep the blood flowing the right way. Smoking, high blood pressure and high cholesterol can make heart trouble more likely.
